title: Hybrid processes and finishing
description: Combining processes: molds and casting from printed or cut masters; vacuum forming; vinyl cutting for graphics; finishing (sanding, priming, paint, sealing); embedding hardware and light (optional).

learningObjectives: Make a simple mold or vacuum-formed part from a fabricated master

content:
Combining processes: molds and casting from printed or cut masters; vacuum forming; vinyl cutting for graphics; finishing (sanding, priming, paint, sealing); embedding hardware and light (optional).

Ideas

Formative processes; the master and the copy; finishing as the difference between prototype and object; material sustainability (PLA, acrylic, MDF waste).

In class

  • Demo rotation (60 min)
  • finishing workshop (60 min)
  • final-project ideation (50 min)
